description: Computes a running average of incoming numeric values using a selectable algorithm (EMA or CA)

inputs.name: Value
inputs.description: Numeric input value to include in the average

inputs.name: Reset
inputs.description: Rising edge resets the average to the current input value

config.name: Algorithm
config.description: Averaging algorithm: EMA (Exponential Moving Average) or CA (Cumulative Average)

config.name: Alpha (smoothing factor)
config.description: EMA smoothing factor (0-1). Higher values give more weight to recent values

state.name: Previous reset state
state.description: Previous state of the reset input for edge detection
